experience.description: Kafka Consulting, with a focus on backup solutions and disaster recovery. We think less deeply about the backup, and much harder about the restore. With dependency graphs of applications, we figure out which cluster state to restore so that reloads and reprocessing are kept at a minimum, while we guarantee no orphans or other unnatural consequences.

Assurance Solution Specialist, Freelance, Communications Industry, Joint Venture of Deutsche Telekom and EWE AG. As GFNW is a carrier of an open-access fiber network, I supported onboarding of several wholesale customers, redesigned the assurance operations, and implemented KRITIS-compliant disaster recovery. Testimonials [2023-12]: 'Du bist wie ein Schweizer Taschenmesser, ohne dich würde was fehlen'

Platform Analysis Specialist, Freelance, Branch of the Meridiam Private Equity platform. I helped jumpstart the business and in close collaboration with C-level prepared IT-systems for selection and implementation: DMS, ERP, and core asset management system (adressmaster, GIS-system, etc.) Testimonials [2022-08]: 'Ja du hast das Team jetzt kennengelernt, Team will dich haben'

Containerisation of a key tool in daily process, with ironing out some quirks in the supplied Docker image; Setup the build pipeline with Terraform, debugged configuration, minor support in operations.

PhD Researcher on Cloud Computing and Communications. I did my dissertation on reliable communications, computation offloading to cloud and edge cloud systems, and cloud provisioning and scaling under uncertainty. I used tinygp, python, kubernetes, tensorflow, and sklearn, as well as special purpose optimisation tooling. I disemminated results in several international projects and conferences (cf.
